transforms: Kept Modwerk's stock-guard form of 0.1.0: the author's floating CavePatch, which carries the stock instruction bytes it expects, is declared as one floating Linked unit with two jmp Detours onto qlr_play and qlr_recrel, every stock expectation an address/length/SHA-256 guard, and the retired 0x400522ca site a named guard verify.py checks.
The unit's reference is the SHA-256 of the author's 196 bytes linked at 0x400d7400 (065cafcb…), with qlr_recrel at 0x84; the docstring describes the source as the author's, unchanged.

stockGuards.note: Retired site: guarded so it stays stock, never written.

notes: patch_qlrec.s, LICENSE and upstream/README.md are the author's files byte for byte at the pinned commit. patch_qlrec.s describes stock routines by address and mnemonic; it contains no firmware bytes.

The author's commit 3ead7f9 writes the flip's battery copy before the setting word, so no run of the USB package repeats stock's PERSONALIZE setter (0x40068ccf). octabam carries the module with the earlier store order at sambanks/octabam 5c71bc8c (PR #861); upstream/OCTABAM_* stay at 6e4aeb7.

The stock guard digests are 0.1.0's, checked again against the original OS 1.40C MAIN image (SHA-256 164f31224bf61181e3f50e7dec40df9afcae5b16dbf6e4c0d0cc5e986af0a84e) by this version's build and gate.
